title: Quick Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and romantic Greek dish perfect for a date night, featuring lamb kebabs marinated in a mixture of red curry paste and herbs, served with a side of warm pita bread made from long fermentation dough, cooked in a copper pot to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the copper pot over medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together red curry paste, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Cook the lamb kebabs in the copper pot for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the long fermentation dough in the copper pot for 2-3 minutes on each side, until puffed and lightly browned.
Wrap the cooked dough in foil to keep warm.
Serve the lamb kebabs with the warm pita bread and a side of mixed greens.
